operation.source_intent: Expose Retry failed only when a failed SEO remediation still has an applicable suggested value, and execute it through the existing authorized remediation path.

acceptance.eligibility: Only site-scoped executions in failed state whose approval remains APPROVED and whose proposed_state is non-empty can transition to queued.
acceptance.concurrency: The failed-to-queued update is conditional inside a transaction, preventing duplicate dispatch when retry requests race.
acceptance.execution_boundary: The HTTP request performs no WordPress mutation; it dispatches the existing tenant-aware ExecuteApprovedSuggestionJob, which preserves the approved execution operation and performs authoritative pre-state and post-mutation re-read verification.
acceptance.attempt_history: Existing attempts are preserved during requeue and increment only when the execution job atomically claims the queued execution.
acceptance.ui_contract: data-testid=seo-retry-failed; operation AIMW-AI-49E68B3816; disabled while busy or when no retryable failed proposal exists.
acceptance.security: Mutation requires seo.write, tenant context remains active, and foreign tenant site identifiers resolve fail-closed.

provenance.reason: Canonical RetryFailedAsync was PENDING and Laravel lacked an operation-specific visible control and authorized retry adapter.
